metric_definitions.time_to_first_partial_s: client monotonic: first audio frame sent -> first nonempty partial received
metric_definitions.final_latency_s: client monotonic: end message sent -> final received
metric_definitions.final_inference_rtf: server-reported final decode time / audio duration. Model call in the worker thread only; EXCLUDES partial decodes, queueing for an inference slot, buffering, and network time
metric_definitions.partial_inference_rtf: server-reported partial decode time / audio covered, per partial; same exclusions
metric_definitions.throughput: completed streams (and audio seconds) / wall clock from first connect to last stream end
metric_definitions.failures: any stream without a final: server error event, connection error, or stream_timeout
